item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
• Refreshed settings icons — the preferences window now uses soft 3D glyphs throughout the sidebar and every row.
  • Everything from 1.1.x: AI session analysis (Claude / GPT / Gemini) with per-screen charts and token counts, saved session history, React Native + Compose/Fragment screen tracking, and a What's New screen.
